meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 装上后，你的智能体会改用电脑本地运行的 Ollama 模型来回复，不再调用 Anthropic 的线上 API。它会把请求指向本地地址，并可选择屏蔽对 Anthropic API 的访问，最终对话由本地模型完成。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体在本地运行、降低 API 费用或尝试开源模型时，向 Claude 提出这些需求即可触发。

say.text: 把名为 test 的代理组切换到本地 Ollama 模型 gemma4
say.note: 会修改该组的容器配置和环境变量。

say.text: 帮我换回 Anthropic API，恢复原来的配置
say.note: 会撤销 Ollama 的配置并重启服务。

howto.what_en: After installation, your agent will use a locally running Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. It redirects requests to a local address and optionally blocks access to Anthropic, so replies come from the local model.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run your agent locally, reduce API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. Just ask Claude for these changes.

say_en.text: Switch the agent group 'test' to the local Ollama model gemma4
say_en.note: Modifies the group's container config and env vars.

say_en.text: Use qwen3-coder for group dev and block the Anthropic API
say_en.note: Sets the model and blocks external API access.

say_en.text: Revert to the Anthropic API and restore original config
say_en.note: Undoes Ollama settings and restarts the service.
